# Nikshay

> > India's National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP) digital platform for TB patient registration, tracking, and health facility management.

Nikshay is operated by the Central TB Division (CTD) under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India, in collaboration with the National Informatics Centre (NIC) and WHO Country Office for India. The platform enables healthcare providers, patients, and community supporters (Ni-kshay Mitra) to participate in India's TB elimination efforts.

## Key Topics

- National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP)
- TB patient registration and tracking
- Central TB Division (CTD)
- Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
- Ni-kshay Mitra (community support program)
- Health facility registration
- Government of India health initiatives
- National Informatics Centre (NIC)
- World Health Organization India
- Tuberculosis management
- Healthcare portal
- Patient surveillance system
- TB elimination strategy

## Core Platform

- [Nikshay](https://nikshay.in): National TB Elimination Programme portal for patient management system
- [About Nikshay](https://nikshay.in/Home/AboutUs): About Nikshay TB patient tracking system by NTEP and Govt of India

## Registration & Onboarding

- [Health Facility Registration](https://nikshay.in/Home/UserFacility): Health facility registration for TB treatment providers and clinics
- [Informant Registration](https://nikshay.in/Home/InformantRegistration): Informant registration for TB case reporting in Nikshay system

## Policies & Privacy

- [Privacy Policy](https://nikshay.in/Home/PrivacyUs): Privacy policy for Nikshay TB patient data and NTEP system

## Optional

- [Beta Environment](https://beta.nikshay.in): Beta version of National TB Elimination Programme portal
- [Demo Environment](https://demo.nikshay.in): Demo/training environment for National TB Elimination Programme system
- [Beta About Page](https://beta.nikshay.in/Home/AboutUs): About page on beta site for Nikshay TB surveillance system
